in_marathi.name: Yudhveer
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Fighter of a War
in_marathi.long_meaning: Yudhveer हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Yudhveer is a combination of two Sanskrit words, 'Yudh' which means 'war' and 'veer' which means 'hero' or 'warrior'. Thus, the name Yudhveer means 'Fighter of a War'.
